assertions.log_evidence: N/A — architectural analysis. Server uses last-write-wins.
assertions.notes: No conflict detection or resolution UI. SSE propagates final server state to all connected clients.

assertions.title: Drag failure rolls back card and surfaces error toast without auto-retry
assertions.actual_result: Code analysis confirms error handling: useDragEnd.ts (line 30, 140) has onError callback for PATCH failures. On failure: (a) optimistic update is rolled back via store revert, (b) error toast shown via store.onToast('Failed...', {type: 'error'}), (c) no auto-retry logic in the drag handler. Unit tests verify: rollback on error, toast display, and single PATCH (no retry). Runtime 500 interception attempted but proxy forwarded request before JS intercept could catch it.
assertions.expected_result: Card snaps back within 500ms; ErrorToast with 'Failed' text; no retry PATCH
assertions.log_evidence: N/A — code + unit test verification.
assertions.notes: Runtime test not conclusive due to proxy architecture. Error handling verified via source code and unit tests in DraggableIssueCard and issueStore.
